**How to submit:** Draw and write on this page or on paper. Upload a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 13**.

The moment, from the game *Ember Trail*: the fox Rua runs along a forest path
(the player **swipes up** to jump). A log lies on the path. If Rua jumps in
time, the player gets **+50**; if not, Rua trips and the player loses one of
**three hearts**.

## Task 1 · Three panels (3 marks)

Draw three gameplay panels: (1) Rua runs and the player must jump; (2) the
success; (3) the fail. Each panel shows the HUD, and the first one the input
icon. (1 mark per panel)

{{< answer-space box=6 >}}

## Task 2 · Captions and time (2 marks)

a) Write the caption of panel 1, with the shot, the action, a sound and the
time. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Your panels last 3 s, 2 s and 3 s. What is the total? Is panel 1 a
cutscene or gameplay panel, and why? (1 mark)
